request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and sincere, acoustic guitar, piano, fiddle, bass, drums, hopeful and steady, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
You are the light of the world
A city on a hill stands tall
Cannot be hidden from the view
No one puts a lamp away
They set it on a stand so high
It gives light to everyone
Inside the house of life

[Chorus]
Let your light shine before others
So they see your good works done
And glorify your Father
Who is seated in heaven
Let your light shine before others
See the good works you do
Glorify your Father above
In the bright and endless view

[Verse]
Do not hide beneath the basket
No one does this in the night
Set it on the stand and stand firm
Let the rays reach every soul
In the same way let it shine
So they see the truth of you
And lift their eyes to heaven
Where your Father waits for you

[Chorus]
Let your light shine before others
So they see your good works done
And glorify your Father
Who is seated in heaven
Let your light shine before others
See the good works you do
Glorify your Father above
In the bright and endless view

[Bridge]
A city set on a hill
Cannot be hidden from sight
Your light is the sign of grace
That leads us through the day
Let it shine for all to see
The goodness God has given
Glorify the Father in heaven
With a heart that is forgiven

[Outro]
Let your light shine before others
Glorify your Father in heaven
